description:
Join International President-Elect Margaret Page, DTM, for a meet-and-greet with the top three winners. Hear the 2021 World Champion share acknowledgments; take the opportunity to ask questions of all the winners.

To learn more about the World Championship of Public Speaking(R) visit https://www.toastmasters.org/events/2021-international-convention/world-championship-of-public-speaking.
 
Please see the Toastmasters International Website about Trademarks and Copyrights by visiting https://www.toastmasters.org/Footer/Conditions-of-Use.
